tokentrim pro slack integration

The tokentrim pro slack integration shows your Claude Code usage and budget alerts in Slack. Add the bot to a channel and get real‑time token spend and daily budget status.

How it works

  1. Install the pro package on up to three machines.
  2. Add the Slack bot to the channel you want to monitor.
  3. The bot posts a daily budget guard message and a weekly digest.
  4. When your budget reaches 80 % it sends an alert.
  5. View detailed usage numbers in the hosted dashboard from any device.

What you get

  • Hosted dashboard on any device.
  • Monday digest and weekly budget alert at 80 %.
  • Slack totals and alerts.
  • Up to 3 machines.
  • Pro lifetime $49 (first 500 buyers) or Pro monthly $9/month.
  • Nothing leaves your machine by default.
  • Requires Python 3.9 or newer; tested on macOS and Linux.

FAQ

How many machines can I use with the pro plan? Up to 3 machines.

What happens when my budget hits 80 %? The Slack bot posts an alert in the channel you configured.

Do I need to pay for each machine separately? No. The pro plan covers all machines in your account.

Get started with the tokentrim pro slack integration
